jobs.description:
Adecco is looking for an enthusiastic Customer Support Officer to strengthen the Volvo Action Service team at Volvo Group! 
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and efficiently. As a Breakdown Assistance Call Handler, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and ensure that every driver receives help as quickly as possible. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed at all times.

This is a role with real impact: thanks to your calm approach, strong communication skills, and solution-oriented mindset, you truly make a difference during stressful situations. Your responsibilities: 

 
• Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing a breakdown on the road. 
 

 
• Analyze the problem by assessing the situation and gathering the necessary information. 
 

 
• Organize interventions and dispatch them to breakdown services, partners, or internal technicians. 
 

 
• Follow up on cases from A to Z, ensuring clear and continuous communication with the driver. 
 

 
• Register all relevant information in the system (time, location, nature of the problem, planning, etc.). 
 

 
• Remain calm in emergency situations and always act with a strong customer focus. 
 

 
• Work closely with a dedicated team that is available 24/7 to provide optimal customer support. 

What do we expect from you? 

 
• You have strong communication skills and are able to handle phone calls clearly, empathetically, and professionally. 
 

 
• You are stress-resistant and able to maintain an overview in busy and demanding situations. 
 
•  
Problem-solving comes naturally to you. 

 
•  
You are fluent in English and German (minimum B2 level) and another European Language. 

 
• You are comfortable working with digital tools and handling administrative follow-up. 
 
•  
You are willing to work flexible shifts: early, late, day and weekends — truck drivers are on the road anytime, anywhere. 

 
•  
Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside/mobility assistance is a plus, but not a requirement. 

 
• You hold a bachelor's degree or have relevant equivalent experience. 
 

 
• You have your own means of transportation.

What will you do?
 
 
 
• Picking and preparing various orders using a handheld scanner or voice picking system. 
 
• Checking, labeling, and securely packaging items. 
 
• Registering goods correctly in the system. 
 
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient operation of the warehouse. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• You have experience as an order picker in a logistics environment. 
 
• You can start quickly and are motivated to learn. 
 
• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts (early-late, or night). 
 
• You speak and understand English well. 
 
• You have your own means of transportation.

jobs.occupation: CONSULTANT REGULATORY AFFAIRS Biocides, junior or medior
jobs.description:
Ensus Consulting BV is a consulting and services firm operating at the interface between science, government and industry. We provide tailor-made Regulatory Affairs dossier management services to national and international customers covering all aspects of dossiers related to chemicals legislations including the Biocidal Products Regulation (BPR), Plant Protection Products Regulation (PPPR), etc. In order to further expand our small regulatory affairs team, we are looking for a highly motivated new colleague.
 

After an initial period of training on-the-job, you will soon be expected to work independently. You will support companies in their regulatory challenges related to chemical products, incl. biocides and pesticides. You coordinate and support regulatory dossiers —covering both national and European chemical legislations— from start to finish. The latter includes for example setting up challenging efficacy testing scenarios, discussions with laboratories on analytical testing, dossier creation, etc. Furthermore, you will be able to take part to European discussions on drafting the guidance and commenting on existing guidance documents.
 

While we strongly value the capacity to work independently, it is also essential to cooperate with your colleagues, external partners and experts, authorities and our (inter)national customers.

The ideal candidate should:
 

be a (recent) graduate (Master or PhD level) in a life sciences discipline (chemistry, biology, biosciences, bioengineering, …).
 

be eager to develop expertise in the main aspects involved in dossier preparation: analytical chemistry, microbiology, (eco)toxicology, exposure assessment, risk assessment, modelling, classification and labelling, ...
 

preferably have relevant experience in research projects, through internships or industry trainee programmes. While demonstrated experience in executing regulatory projects (BPR, PPPR, CLP, … ) would be beneficial, it is not strictly required.
 

have the following analytical skills: a keen eye for detail, collecting and analysing data with a critical eye, enjoying solving complex problems.
 

have excellent writing (English) and organisational skills, good interpersonal skills, responsibility and a critical mind.
 

have sound skills in Microsoft Office Word, Excel and PowerPoint, and will become proficient in IUCLID 6, a software application to manage scientific data on chemicals which is used in the implementation of various regulatory programmes, after an on-the-job training.

Do you have kitchen experience and enjoy working with fresh products? Are you hands-on, reliable, and looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow? Then we would love to meet you!
 

Your responsibilities
 

As a Production Kitchen Worker, you will be part of a motivated team responsible for preparing and processing fresh vegetables on a daily basis.
 

Your tasks include:
 

 
• Cleaning and washing vegetables.
 
• Cutting and preparing vegetables both manually and with machines.
 
• Operating vegetable cutting equipment safely and efficiently.
 
• Maintaining a clean and hygienic work environment.
 
• Following quality and food safety standards. 

 
• Previous experience in a professional kitchen is required.
 
• You are comfortable with physical work and enjoy staying active.
 
• You work accurately and pay attention to hygiene.
 
• You are available to work on Mondays and Saturdays.
 
• You can start work between 6:00 AM and 7:00 AM.
 
• You speak English or Dutch.
 
• Experience working in Belgium is not required.

Or you have a strong Sales mindset and looking for your first job?

This is not a traditional HR role. You will build your own market, develop new business, headhunt top IT talent and manage the recruitment process from A to Z.

jobs.occupation: Senior Accountant in the Brabant Wallon
jobs.description:
As part of the finance team, you will take ownership of several legal entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg, with the opportunity to gradually expand your responsibilities and make a visible impact on the organization's future.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the full accounting cycle for several entities across Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.
• Handle daily accounting operations, including purchase invoices, bank transactions, payments, reconciliations, and journal entries.
• Prepare monthly and year-end closings, provisions, accruals, and supporting financial analyses.
• Ensure timely VAT, Intrastat, and statutory reporting obligations are met.
• Prepare annual accounts and support audit activities in collaboration with the Chief Accountant.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of accounting processes and support ad hoc finance projects.

• Holds a degree in Accounting, Finance, or equivalent professional experience.
• Speaks fluent French and Dutch ; English is a great asset.
• Has solid end-to-end accounting experience and is comfortable managing entities autonomously.
• Has a strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting, VAT, and statutory obligations.
• Is structured, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Demonstrates ambition, curiosity, and a willingness to take on increasing responsibilities over time.
• Thrives in a pragmatic, hands-on, and collaborative environment where initiative is valued.

For our client, we are looking for a motivated INDUSTRIAL CLEANER.
 

 
• Assisting with emptying the tunnels (partially mechanical/partially manual)
 
• Cleaning large tunnels using a high-pressure cleaner
 
• Assisting with filling the tunnels
 
• Thinking along when adding quantities of spawn
 
• Cleaning transport belts at height (no fear of heights!) 

What do we expect from you as an industrial cleaner?
 

 
• You have some initial experience as an industrial cleaner
 
• You are in good physical health and not afraid to work in a dirty environment
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5-13 & 13-21)
 
• You actively contribute to the cleaning process
 
• You are a team player but can also work independently
 
• You speak Dutch, French or English

What are your responsibilities as a forklift driver?
 

 
• Receiving and correctly storing incoming goods in the warehouse
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Scanning products in and out using a scanning system
 
• Operating a forklift (approximately 80% of the time) and an electric pallet truck (approximately 20%)
 
• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace
 
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift 

 
• You hold a valid forklift certificate
 
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters
 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
 
• You work accurately and value order and structure
 
• Safety is always your top priority
 
• You enjoy working independently but also function well within a team

jobs.occupation: Food Production Operator (Early, Late or Night Shift)
jobs.description:
What will you do as a Packaging Operator in the Food Industry?
 

 
• Operate, set up and monitor packaging and weighing machines
 
• Check the quality and correct weight of packaged products
 
• Identify and resolve minor malfunctions or report them in a timely manner
 
• Perform quality control checks, including metal detection tests
 
• Help maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment 

 
• Experience as an operator or with packaging machines is an advantage, but not required
 
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for quality
 
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
 
• A forklift certificate is a plus
 
• You are willing to work in a chilled environment (5°C to 10°C)
 
• You are willing to work in shifts (6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM, or 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM)
